account: In the International Telecommunication Union report published on 29 October 2025, the #BlackTechFutures Research Institute submits the HEART Engine use case, with Dr. Fallon Wilson listed first among its contacts. HEART Engine uses adaptive prompts, supervised recommendation models and conversational agents to personalize training. It also uses them to connect learners with opportunities. The institute lists Spelman College and Ebenezer Baptist Church as testbeds. It names Spelman College, Meharry Medical College and Stillman College as post-secondary anchors. It names Microsoft, Omidyar Network and the Kapor Center among funders and infrastructure partners. The report does not quantify any gain in learning or job placement.
